An attacker can inject Jinja2 template expressions (e.g. {{7*7}}, {{config.items()}}, or {{self.__init__.__globals__}}) to achieve server-side template injection, leading to remote code execution.

extra.message: The 'name' query parameter is directly interpolated into an HTML response via an f-string and returned as HTMLResponse. Untrusted input is reflected unsanitized into the response body, allowing reflected cross-site scripting (XSS).

The Template(content).render() call on line 41 renders a Jinja2 template whose contents include attacker-controlled input. This SSTI sink can be abused to execute arbitrary Python code when the attacker injects template expressions through the 'name' parameter.
